content.hebrew: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא, עוֹז הִתְאַזַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta ḳadosh venora, ‘oz hit’azzarta.
content.english: You are holy and awesome, and are girded in might.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה הוֹפַֽעְתָּ שְׁכִינָתְךָ בְּמִשְׁכָּן בָּחַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta hofa‘ta shekhinatekha bemishkan baḥarta.
content.english: You made Your presence appear in the Tabernacle, which You chose.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה רָצִֽיתָ עַמְּךָ וְאֹתוֹ הֶאֱמַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta ratsita ‘ammekha ve’oto he’emarta.
content.english: You have desired Your people, and made them glorious.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה נוֹחֲלֵי דָתְךָ – בְּכֹהֲנֵי קְדֻשָּׁה אֹתָם פֵּאַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta noḥalē datekha – bekhohanē ḳedush’sha otam pe’arta.
content.english: You have rendered glory unto them that inherit Your law, by [giving them] priests of holiness.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה בְּשִׁבְעַת יְמֵי מִלּוּאִים אֹתָם סָפַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta beshiv‘at yemē millu’im otam safarta.
content.english: You counted seven days of inauguration [for] them.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה כֹּהֲנֶֽיךָ הִלְבַּֽשְׁתָּ בִּגְדֵי יֶֽשַׁע, וְנֵֽזֶר בְּרֹאשָׁם עִטַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta kohanekha hilbashta biḡdē yesha‘, venezer berosham ‘ittarta.
content.english: You clothed Your priests in garments of success, and crowned their heads with a diadem.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה בַּשְּׁמִינִי לְהַקְרִיב קָרְבָּנָם הִזְכַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta bash’shemini lehaḳriv ḳorbanam hizkarta.
content.english: You notified them to offer their sacrifice on the eighth day.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה כְּבוֹדְךָ אֲלֵיהֶם הִרְאִֽיתָ וְהֶאֱדַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta kevodekha alehem hir’ita vehe’edarta.
content.english: You showed Your Glory to them and ennobled it.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה אֵשׁ לֶאֱכוֹל הָעוֹלָה מִמְּרוֹמִים גָּזַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta esh le’ekhol ha‘ola mimmeromim gazarta.
content.english: You decreed a fire to consume the burnt offering from on high.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא – בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה הֶעְדַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta Nadav va’Avihu – behaḳrivam esh zara he‘darta.
content.english: You annihilated Nadab and Abihu, when they offered a foreign fire.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה יַֽיִן וְשֵׁכָר לְבַל יִשְׁתּוּ בְּשָׁעַת עֲבוֹדָה הִזְהַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta yayin veshekhar leval yishtu besha‘at ‘avoda hizharta.
content.english: You admonished them not to drink wine or strong drink at the time of their service.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחוֹל אָמַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta lehavdil ben ḳodesh leḥol amarta.
content.english: You said to distinguish between holy and profane.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה לְהוֹרוֹת בֵּין טָמֵא לְטָהוֹר אֲשֶׁר טִהַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta lehorot ben tamē letahor asher tiharta.
content.english: You [commanded the priests] to give instruction [to distinguish] between the impure and the pure that You have made pure.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה בְּסִימְנֵי אוֹת הוֹרֵֽיתָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta besimenē ot horeta ka’asher dibbarta.
content.english: You taught the marks and signs, as You have spoken [them].

content.hebrew: אַתָּה לְבַל יְשַׁקְּצוּ נַפְשָׁם, בָּנֶֽיךָ הֶאֱמַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta leval yeshaḳḳetsu nafsham banekha he’emarta.
content.english: You said to Your children that they should not make themselves vile.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה קִדַּֽשְׁתָּ לְעַמְּךָ בְּמִצְוֹת, וְהִגְבַּֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta ḳiddashta le‘ammekh bemitsvot, vehiḡbarta,
content.english: You have sanctified Your people with commandments, and made them strong.

content.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד, וְהֵם גּוֹי אֶחָד הוֹתַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Atta eḥad, vehem goy eḥad hotarta.
content.english: You are one, and they are one nation, which you have preserved.

content.hebrew: קהל: אַתָּה נוֹרָא, וְכֻלָּם יָצַֽרְתָּ, וְלֹא נוֹצַֽרְתָּ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Atta nora vekhullam yatsarta, velo notsarta.
content.english: Cong. You are awesome, and You created all, but You were not created.

content.hebrew: חזן: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃ (תהלים קב:כח)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ve’atta hu ushnotekha lo yittammu:
content.english: Cantor. And You are He, whose days will never end. (Ps. 102:28)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
